_notes: Canonical MCP server config for ai4comms. Edit only this file. Run scripts/render-mcp.py to regenerate .mcp.json / .gemini/settings.json / .codex/config.toml / .vscode/mcp.json.
_connection_model: Authenticated HTTP MCPs (interactive OAuth, e.g. asset-broker) are consumed as Cowork workspace connectors — do NOT declare them here; a plugin-declared OAuth MCP can only auth via a localhost loopback that fails in remote sessions. Only no-auth HTTP MCPs (stromy-format) and stdio servers belong in a plugin. See infra-docs/ai/mcp-connection-model.md (enforced by validate-plugin-completeness.py Invariant #13).

stromy-format._notes: Hosted format skills fetched at runtime via fs_read from the stromy-format MCP.

nl-gov-data._notes: Dutch government open-data MCP — search/fetch legislation, parliamentary records, Rijksoverheid documents, plus the twelve intel/analysis skills (nl-gov-data, nl-monitor, nl-tensions, nl-accountability, nl-policy-legislative-landscape, nl-parliamentary-positioning, nl-issue-framing, nl-dossier-tracker, nl-eu-transposition, nl-evidence-grounding, nl-horizon-scan, nl-guide). Unauthenticated (catalog auth: null), which is what makes it plugin-declarable under Invariant #13. AI4comms is Dutch ('s-Hertogenbosch) and serves public-affairs clients, so the NL gov record is a primary evidence source. Composes with stromy-format for rendering.
